name: link
title: Link
purpose: Navigate to another location with consistent Balsa styling and safe external-link behavior.
avoidFor: Actions that do not change location
Icon-only links without an accessible name
accessibility: External links receive a new browsing context and noreferrer protection.
Icon-only usage requires the label prop.
commonMistakes: Using Link for an in-place action.
Omitting a useful accessible name from an icon-only link.
Adding a theme-specific glass variant instead of allowing outline to inherit the Glassmorphism material recipe.

examples.title: Text
examples.description: The text variant fits links embedded alongside prose and metadata.
examples.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import Link from "@/components/ui/Link.vue";
</script>

<template>
  <Link href="/docs">Link placeholder</Link>
</template>

examples.title: Outline
examples.description: Outline links can present navigation as a secondary call to action.
examples.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import Link from "@/components/ui/Link.vue";
import { ArrowRight } from "@lucide/vue";
</script>

<template>
  <Link href="/docs" variant="outline" color="secondary" :suffix-icon="ArrowRight">Link placeholder</Link>
</template>

examples.title: External
examples.description: External links expose their destination behavior and matching icon.
examples.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import Link from "@/components/ui/Link.vue";
import { ExternalLink } from "@lucide/vue";
</script>

<template>
  <Link href="/docs" :suffix-icon="ExternalLink" external>Link placeholder</Link>
</template>

composition.neutralColor: Neutral is the chrome color: a filled neutral action uses the inverse pair and every quieter treatment resolves to the plain foreground, so toolbar and shell controls do not compete with the content they frame.
